answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 1952 Country: United Kingdom Title: Is it permissible for a woman to wear a tika or mathaputi (forehead jewellery)? Do these have any religious connotations for hindus? Question: Assalaamu 'alaikum Is it permissible for a woman to wear a tika or mathaputi (forehead jewellery)? Do these have any religious connotations for hindus? JazakAllah khairan. Answer ID: 1952 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 633/628=M) Tika (forehead jewellery) is a Hindu custom. Muslim women should refrain from using it. The Haidth says: من تشبہ بقوم فھو منھم Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
